# Original weighted-mesh fixture

`weighted-triangle.json` is an original minimal Spine 4.3 JSON fixture authored
from the public [JSON mesh contract](https://esotericsoftware.com/spine-json-format).
It has three vertices, more than four influences on one vertex, repeated and
zero-weight influences, and a rounded positive total below one. Coordinates,
weights, skeleton names, and topology were authored for this test. No artist
asset or editor/runtime implementation was used.
